task: Strip Claude pasted_content wrapper tags (keeping enclosed text) from the claude-code-otlp UserPromptSubmit hook prompt before the 200-char truncation, with regression tests and an architecture-doc update.

key_reasoning.reason: Core behaviour is defined (strip tags, keep text, before 200-char cut), but the fix location (Claude handler only vs OtlpAgentAdapter base class) and handling of unverified format variants (mid-prompt, multiple, unterminated blocks) are open; scored M, below L because the primary path is single and well-identified.

Closest pattern is the spread-override of derived fields in onUserPromptSubmit (asserted by the prompt_length spoof test) plus the pure helpers in ticket-parser.ts and event-fields/command-fields.ts. It does not cover the repeated-id closing tag (a standard paired-tag regex fails), and the AC enumerates edge cases (mid-prompt, multiple, unterminated) with no existing edge-case table template, so Technical Risk is bumped to M. Derived fields (prompt_length, tickets, command_name) must stay on raw text; masking order is unchanged. No security-sensitive injection surface, so no L floor.

About 4-5 modified files (claude-code-otlp plugin, optionally claude.metrics-processor, ARCHITECTURE-OTLP-PLUGIN.md, extended plugin test and metrics-processor test) plus 1-2 new files (pure helper in src/agents/core/ and its unit test) across src/agents and docs.

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from S to M: acceptance criteria enumerate edge cases (multiple, mid-prompt, unterminated blocks, --name sessions) and no existing parameterized edge-case test template covers this pattern; the closest precedent (paired-tag stripping) does not handle the repeated-id closing tag.
